rows.name: Minehead
rows.description: Fix. gr. lt. on pier, 3h. before to 2½h. after H.W.

rows.name: Watchet Breakwater
rows.description: Fixed red Tide light, 8 ft. flood to 10 ft. ebb...

rows.name: Burnham, or Bridgewater
rows.character: Upper light occulting bright, 1 min. Lower light fixed bright or red
rows.description: On East side of entrance to River. In one, E. by S. ½ S., 1,500 ft. apart. High lt. eclipsed twice in quick succession, then visible for 54 secs.; white tower, 99 ft. high. Low light, square tower, 36 ft. high, with black streak; bright between W. ¾ N. and W.N.W.; red over the bar between W. by N. and W. ½ N.; and red up the river between S. by W. and S. by W. ½ W.

rows.name: Clevedon
rows.description: One fixed red light on pier-head

rows.name: Portishead
rows.description: One fixed bright light on pier

rows.name: Breaksea Lightvessel
rows.description: In 18 fathoms, 2 miles N.W. by W. ¾ W. from One-fathom Bank buoy. Red, with ball ...

rows.name: Avon
rows.character: One occulting br., red, or green lt., ½ min.
rows.description: White tower, 65 ft., on E. side of channel. Lt. eclipsed 3 secs. in ev. ½ min. A red sector to N.W., & a green ray from W. to W. by S. at turn of channel. A fix. red lt. 230 yds. to N.W.

rows.name: Avonmouth
rows.description: Low lt. from red hut on N.W. pt. of Dumball Id., high lt. from pole on white hut on mainland, 750 yds. to E. by S.; leading lights through King Road. Lights at Avonmouth Dock entrance, red on North side, blue on South side

rows.name: English & Welsh Grounds
rows.description: Lightvessel on South side of channel, in 4½ fathoms. Red, with ball.

rows.name: New Passage
rows.description: Lights on piers and Charstone Rk. for steamers

rows.name: River Severn
rows.description: 1. One fix. Tide lt. on N. pier-hd. of tidal basin. 1 red lt. N.E. of pier when specially required 2. Red light on centre pier, and bright light at landward extreme of each wide arch .........

rows.name: FLATHOLM
rows.character: One occult. br. or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 99 ft. high, on South point. Lt. eclipsed 3 secs. twice in ev. ½ min.; red betw. N.W. ¾ W. and N. by W. ½ W.; thence bright to N. ½ W., from Ranie Spit Shoal to West Cardiff buoy; and thence red to N.E.

rows.name: Usk (Newport)
rows.character: One fixed bright, red, or green light
rows.description: White tower, 57 ft. high, on West side. Light bright betw. S.W. by W. ¾ W. and S.S.W.; thence red to S. by E. ½ E.; thence bright over river entrance to S.E. by S. ½ S.; thence red to the land. Green up the river between E. by N. ½ N. and N.E. by E. ½ E.........

rows.name: Cardiff
rows.description: Two red lights, about 23 yards apart, and two bright lights, near docks. A bright light on Bute Dock pier-head .........................

rows.name: NASH POINT
rows.character: Two fixed bright lights, and lower fixed red lt.
rows.description: White towers, 111 & 60 ft. high, 1,000 ft. apart, N.W. by W. ¾ W. In line lead South of Nash Sand. High lt. red North of S.E. ½ E., and from a window below a red light is shown over Tuskar Rock, between N.W. ½ N. and N.W. by N. Low light obscured North of N.N.W., and high light North of N.W. ½ W. ........................

rows.name: Porthcawl Harbour
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright, red, or green light 2. Two fixed red lights
rows.description: 1. On S.E. end of breakwater. Bright betw. S.W. by W. ½ W. and W. by N. ½ N.; red to North and green to East of this sector......... 2. Horizontal, on inner part of breakwater, when gates are open ................................

rows.name: Briton Ferry
rows.description: Three Tide lights on East training wall .........

rows.name: Neath
rows.description: Two fixed br. Tide lts. on end of training wall

rows.name: Swansea Harbour
rows.character: 1. One fixed red Tide lt. 2. One fixed bright lt. 3. One fixed bright lt. 4. Two green or red lts. 5. Two green or red lts. 6. One green or red light
rows.description: 1. White tower on West pier-head; shown while 8 ft. water, April 1 to Nov. 30, and while 10 ft. during winter. Black ball by day 2. On inner part of W. pier, vis. only to eastwd. 3. Electric light on East pier-head .............. 4. and 5. At South dock, vertically; at North dock, horizontally; red when closed, green when open ............................ 6. At New Cut bridge; red when closed ......

rows.name: Scarweather Sand Lt.-V.
rows.description: Off West end of Sand, in 14 fathoms. Red, with half globe above usual globe..............

rows.name: MUMBLES
rows.description: White tower, 56 feet high, on outer islet ......

rows.name: Helwick Lightvessel
rows.description: In 16½ fathoms, off West end of Sand. Red, with ball at mast-head............................

rows.name: Llanelly
rows.description: One on Whiteford Point (on piles) from half-flood to half-ebb; other from half-flood to quarter-ebb on South end of breakwater ...
